usedFor: Shopify tracks orders, and Workflowy collects notes when “Order Cancelled” runs “Create Node”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create Node” in Workflowy
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order lands as a node with a note, optionally under a parent like your inbox.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so nodes from it appear after a scheduled check.
